exit_criteria: Strategy artifact reads are DB-backed and do not globally reconcile or probe MT5.
Safe cleanup remains distinct from explicit Strategy Workspace Reset; reset preserves baseline, schema, generic settings and Scientist provider configuration.
Corrupt generated rows can be reset through controlled ownership boundaries; SQLite corruption enters RECOVERY_REQUIRED and requires explicit backup/reset confirmation.
Champion replacement and active Challenger lifecycle are correct and covered by focused tests.

Active Research APIs/modules/pages/tables/runtime dependencies and current R00-R02 sequence authority are removed; future R00-R11 phases are PLANNED and blocked until the Owner declares a real MT5 sample READY.
Backend/frontend regressions, governance, source-only scan and Windows GitHub Actions pass; no real research or broker/MT5 scientific execution occurs.

phases.title: Strategy Optimizer durability and performance hardening
phases.objective: Restore the previously proven native MT5 Optimizer launch behavior while retaining independent durability fixes, and prevent parser duplicate-vector failures or exact duplicate candidates from hiding completed results.
exit_criteria: Editable Optimizer draft persists independently from each immutable started-job request snapshot; schema migration and reset/recovery use the same current schema authority.
Worker launch, startup reconciliation, STOP and RESUME bind to durable job/token/PID/process identity; uncertain MT5 execution is never blindly relaunched and unrelated MT5 is never killed.

Round raw evidence is frozen and verified; derived evidence publishes as one immutable bundle before database authority advances; replay is deterministic and partial staging cannot masquerade as committed evidence.
Qualified-candidate reads use a bounded SQLite projection with server-side pagination; Challenger mutation still verifies retained canonical evidence.
Frontend preview/search/poll/mutation requests cancel or reject stale responses, are bounded/adaptive, and display immediate pending/block/success/error feedback.

The production Optimizer launches terminal64.exe with the native /config INI path; MT5 retains its natural local tester-agent behavior and Owner-selected settings. No MAX-owned Job Object ActiveProcessLimit or estimated 14-GiB terminal / 12-GiB-per-agent admission gate may block START.
Legacy memory calibration from capped runs is ignored; no pagefile mutation, search-space reduction, batching, or split optimization is introduced.
Repeated report-sidecar rows with the same parameter vector are collapsed only when all semantic metric fields match; conflicting metrics remain fail-closed.
Exact duplicate candidate identities are removed before SQLite persistence, including duplicates across rounds, and the persistence boundary rejects duplicate identities transactionally.
Frozen requests, authenticated worker identity, crash reconciliation, atomic evidence publication, bounded read projections, and stale-response protection remain intact.
Owner runtime and full Optimizer acceptance remain NOT_PROVEN until the Owner verifies a fresh run; this source phase does not run MT5 or alter real research/scientific authority.
Backend/frontend regression, zero-warning lint, build, dependency checks, source-only/security, governance and exact Windows CI pass; Owner runtime remains NOT_PROVEN.

phases.title: P0 fail-closed database schema safety
phases.objective: P0A added fail-closed schema-15 startup, migration, recovery, and reset guards. P0A was accepted and merged at 8ba001bba31d7c74e2d1d1aa03d6c79fb0f9576a; the Owner database itself remains uninspected.
exit_criteria: Before initialization, baseline registration, migration, reconciliation, recovery, or reset, perform read-only schema preflight. Schema versions newer than 15 report INCOMPATIBLE_NEWER_SCHEMA; missing/corrupt metadata and unresolved SQLite WAL/journal state fail closed with diagnostic status and no automatic reset.
Direct migration and recovery/reset entrypoints independently enforce the schema guard. Fresh installation and valid schema-15 startup/migration behavior remain covered by regression tests.

Synthetic temporary-database adversarial tests prove zero mutation for schema 16/future schemas with ONNX/research/artifact evidence, invalid metadata, sidecars, repeated startup and direct entrypoints; physical hashes, logical rows/objects, and foreign-key results are compared.
Launcher reports schema incompatibility or unsafe metadata/journal state explicitly and does not offer reset or hide the cause behind the generic readiness timeout.

Backend, frontend, launcher, dependency, source-only/secret, pinned Skill Workflow, Project Truth, sequence and exact-tree Windows CI gates pass. No Owner database, MT5, Optimizer, Champion, research training or real runtime is used.
P0A was merged at the accepted main authority above; its exact P0A acceptance remains external evidence under D-012. No Owner database was accessed.

phases.title: P0B schema-16 compatibility and non-destructive cutover
phases.objective: Implement and prove a structurally verified, non-destructive compatibility path for the historical schema-16 archive extension without restoring cancelled ONNX/Research runtime, downgrading schema metadata, or accessing the Owner database.
exit_criteria: Historical migrations from accepted schema-15 baseline through schema 16 are source-audited; exact ONNX archive DDL, indexes, triggers, relationships, and historical Research purge behavior are documented.

Schema 16 is accepted only when the schema-15 application core and exact historical ONNX archive extension match a pinned structural contract; unknown/future versions or layouts remain blocked before read-write access.

Schema-16 compatibility startup and migration entrypoints preserve schema_version=16 and do not create, drop, rewrite, purge, or automatically recover records/files; ambiguous in-flight operational state blocks with explicit reconciliation diagnostics.

Synthetic populated fixtures prove Strategy, Optimizer, Challenger, Champion, Scientist, artifact, research-prefixed and ONNX archive rows and relationships remain intact across startup, repeated startup, and crash/retry cases.

A copy-only staging/cutover tool creates and verifies an isolated candidate plus rollback image/report; it never overwrites or activates the source automatically, and activation requires a distinct explicit Owner authorization.

Fresh install and schema-15 migration behavior remain unchanged; schema 17+ and structurally incompatible schema 16 fail closed. Pending WAL/journal states are handled without deletion or unsafe replay.

Full backend/frontend, launcher, dependency, governance, Skill Workflow, security/source-only and exact-tree Windows CI gates pass. Owner database/runtime, MT5, Optimizer execution, research, Champion mutation, and live cutover remain NOT_PROVEN / NOT_EXECUTED.
